correctness.rationale: The pairmap is a bijection to flip-equivariant endomaps, with product reversed. The retraction normal form and orbit conservation give a complete parameterization. The entire unit group consists of signed permutations of free flip-orbits and ordinary permutations of fixed flip-orbits. Root-cluster stabilizers produce the orbit formula; the equation eg=ge forces fiberwise choices and yields the commutant product. Covers all n>=1. Direct exhaustive composition checks passed for 16 maps (n=2) and 19683 maps (n=3), all idempotent conjugacy orbits, and centralizer representatives.

value.rationale: Provides a natural complete classification of unit-conjugacy orbits of all magma-monoid idempotents, their precise multiplicities and commuting-partner statistics, not merely global count. The profiles distinguish identical-image-size retractions and remain meaningful for arbitrarily many underlying points; already n=3 yields 31 inequivalent classes among 706 idempotents. These are standard structural questions in finite semigroup theory, not a renamed scalar count.
